warnings: Budget Tier Compromise: Alice prefers Tier 2 (moderate) while Bob prefers Tier 3 (high/luxury). As a compromise, the itinerary selects high-quality boutique accommodations (The Knot Tokyo Shinjuku and Hotel Resol Kyoto Kawaramachi Sanjo) that provide upscale aesthetic comfort without exceeding mid-tier budgets, along with thoughtfully curated dining experiences.

Morning Routine Compromise: Alice prefers an early start (6:00 AM - 8:00 AM) while Bob prefers a late start (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM). Group activities and transfers have been scheduled with a compromise start around 8:50 AM - 9:00 AM. This gives Alice quiet personal morning time for peaceful strolls or coffee while allowing Bob to sleep in reasonably and not feel rushed.
